title: Not Scary
description: A Modpack that aims to be scary without anny Horror Mods
body:
# About
This Modpack aims to be scary without any Horror Mods

# Features
- You always spawn in a Dark Forest, Moolight Valley or a Pale Garden.
- The Modpack has Mods and Resource Packs that add scary sounds and scary music.
- The core of this Modpack is the Spooklementary shader by SpacEagle17.
- It uses Terralith for more Biomes.
- This Modpack also has some other performance and Quality of Life Mods.
